name: Phi-2
description:
Here is how to read the Phi-2 config.json. The architecture class is PhiForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,560: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 51,200 × 2,560: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 32, so each head sees 80 dimensions (2,560 / 32). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2560 / 32 = 80. 80 is a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 32, so this is multi-head attention (MHA): every query head keeps its own key/value.

num_hidden_layers is 32: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 10,240. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 2,560-wide stream is projected up, activated with gelu_new, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 2,048 tokens — the context window in the config. There is no rope_scaling entry, so the rotary positions are used as-is. rope_theta is 10000.0: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 51,200. 51,200 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is float16.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/microsoft/phi-2/blob/main/config.json.
